description: Full localized specs for ANY variant in the catalogue, in 20 languages. Paid per call with x402 (USDC) — $0.05. Not charged when the id is unknown.

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.

variant_id.description: Opaque variant id from search_catalogue, e.g. v_1a2b3c4d

name: get_specs_full

last_synced_at.description: ISO-8601 time the data was last synced — surface it with the specs

confidence.description: Confidence score 0–1 for this value; null when not scored

label.description: Spec name in the requested language

unit.description: Unit of the value (km, kW, l/100km, …); null when unitless

value.description: The value: a string, number or boolean, already localized. Absent when the source holds no value

specs.description: Every spec the variant carries, keyed by spec key (e.g. range_wltp_km)

variant_id.description: Opaque variant id, e.g. v_1a2b3c4d. Pass it to get_specs / get_images / compare_variants.

year_to.description: Last production year; 0 or null while still in production

title: Get full specs, any variant (paid)
